description: Defines a template-based intrusive linked list implementation with hooks, iterators, and list management functions.

classes.name: IntrusiveListHook
classes.description: Represents a hook for intrusive list nodes, managing links and unlinking.

classes.name: ListIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing the intrusive list.

classes.name: IntrusiveList
classes.description: Template class implementing an intrusive linked list.

methods.name: link_before
methods.description: Links the current hook before the specified next node.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes the node from the list, updating neighboring links.

methods.name: is_linked
methods.description: Checks if the node is currently linked in a list.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next node.

methods.name: operator--
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous node.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the specified position in the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.
